answer: Each agent stakes a pearl of collateral bound to a hardware attestation key, so a sybil clone cannot reuse a peer's identity without duplicating the physical root of trust. Rendezvous handshakes echo the staked key through a willow-structured Merkle registry, letting honest nodes cross-check burn schedules against one canonical stake tree. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
